parameters.query:
-- BCP temporary patients registered during the outage window.
-- The edge record is never modified by this workflow (BCP plan rule 8).
SELECT
  id, mrn, patient_name, gender, date_of_birth, mobile_number,
  care_setting, ward_name, bed_number, consultant_name,
  visit_number, business_date, active_from, created_at
FROM bcp_active_patient
WHERE source_system = 'BCP_LOCAL'
  AND tenant_id = '{{ $env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID }}'
  AND created_at >= '{{ $json.windowStart }}'::timestamp
  AND created_at <  '{{ $json.windowEnd }}'::timestamp
ORDER BY created_at;

parameters.query:
-- Every BCP clinical note written during the outage window, for synced
-- and temporary patients alike. Append-only: nothing here is edited.
SELECT
  id, mrn, encounter_id, visit_number, note_type, content,
  author_username, author_full_name, author_role, created_at
FROM bcp_clinical_note
WHERE tenant_id = '{{ $env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID }}'
  AND created_at >= '{{ $('Outage Window').first().json.windowStart }}'::timestamp
  AND created_at <  '{{ $('Outage Window').first().json.windowEnd }}'::timestamp
ORDER BY created_at;
